openFindings.title: Obsolete /spec_kit: command prefix survives in the shipped phase-parent template and five reference docs, and no ledger row ever owned it
Parent spec launch precondition names swe-2-max as the benchmark subject, contradicting its own Out of Scope section and frozen decision D8
The post-edit hook placeholder scan cannot see the colon token form the v2.3 templates now emit
The scan exits 1 on 55 legitimate bracketed matches in this strict-passing packet, so the hook blocks its own packet
Both new guards depend on rg without a preflight or declaration, and the drift guard prints EXAMPLE_DRIFT_OK on a drifted tree when rg is absent
template-mapping.md still teaches [PLACEHOLDER] as the marker to replace and no validator detects it
graph-metadata.json derived.status says in_progress while the parent reads Complete and last_active_child_id is still phase 004
Parent Branch metadata reads main while every phase ran on the worktree branch
Two parent-spec pointers dangle: Parent Spec ../spec.md and the phase 003 decision record
Continuity frontmatter was never refreshed when seven phase documents closed and the parent still sends a reader to phase 001
Phase 009 acceptance rows carry the benchmark on the superseded first set, so the deciding set has no acceptance row
Benchmark report subject line still names swe-2-max although the deciding set ran on DeepSeek
Placeholder marker sets diverge: the orchestrator flags the legacy angle-bracket form and the shell mirror never sees it
Fence detection differs between the orchestrator and the shell mirror, and a second fence helper in the same file recognises tilde fences the gate does not
The code-block exclusion skips only fence delimiter lines, so fenced example content is still scanned
Card sync checks its fourth surface only negatively, so a checklist that names no example passes
The drift guard has no coverage floor over the example tree, so an empty level directory fails with a misleading description message
Phase 006 summary attributes the card and the filled example to four agent definitions but three carry neither
The plan asset describes authoring and names the guard scripts but neither the card nor the v2.3 token form
template-mapping.md states decision-record.md is required while the contract makes it optional and this packet omits it in all nine phases
The two new catalog sections are linked from the playbook but carry no verification marker
Two run-set files are named baseline.json while neither holds a baseline
The deciding delta.json carries arithmetic with no experiment identity
The L3+ clarifier reaches all six tasks.md sections and none of the three plan.md sections with the same heading
